	<div id='main' role='main' class='all_colors' data-scroll-offset='100'>

	<div class='stretch_full container_wrap alternate_color light_bg_color empty_title  title_container'><div class='container'><div class="breadcrumb breadcrumbs avia-breadcrumbs"><div class="breadcrumb-trail" ><span class="trail-before"><span class="breadcrumb-title">You are here:</span></span> <span  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/BreadcrumbList" ><span  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/ListItem" itemprop="itemListElement" ><a itemprop="url" href="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/en/" title="LOGOS Beach Village" rel="home" class="trail-begin"><span itemprop="name">Home</span></a><span itemprop="position" class="hidden">1</span></span></span> <span class="sep">/</span> <span  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/BreadcrumbList" ><span  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/ListItem" itemprop="itemListElement" ><a itemprop="url" href="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/en/sports/" title="Sports"><span itemprop="name">Sports</span></a><span itemprop="position" class="hidden">2</span></span></span> <span class="sep">/</span> <span class="trail-end">Kite</span></div></div></div></div><div id='av_section_1'  class='avia-section av-2lxfm5-b1d12cb6e4fe12016fb422f44570def9 main_color avia-section-default avia-no-border-styling  avia-builder-el-0  avia-builder-el-no-sibling  avia-bg-style-scroll container_wrap fullsize'  ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><main  role="main" itemprop="mainContentOfPage"  class='template-page content  av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-1148'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'>
<div  class='flex_column av-2d2af1-820bf03b8fc0497161afeaa9a2b28246 av_one_full  avia-builder-el-1  el_before_av_one_half  avia-builder-el-first  first flex_column_div  '     ><div  class='av-special-heading av-kvjbrm2e-189492cc3fafc6d1bc3b03c93de450c1 av-special-heading-h1 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-2  avia-builder-el-no-sibling '><h1 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >Keep calm and go kitesurfing</h1><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div></div><div  class='flex_column av-281azh-179ce0d932ed2179cdc0f6af5854e0c4 av_one_half  avia-builder-el-3  el_after_av_one_full  el_before_av_one_half  first flex_column_div  column-top-margin'     ><section  class='av_textblock_section av-kvjbs998-c0d4633306033274f4dfd243e9873143 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>The <a href="https://www.surfandkitetheologos.com/location/kite/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">kite center</a> offers enough space on the beach and on the water and invites with its approximately 2500 sqm large property for kitesurfing in Rhodes. For the rental as well as the training of all skill levels you can always expect the latest material of the brands Core and Carved. At the station you will have over 90 kites and 45 boards at your disposal, which are in perfect condition, as they are replaced several times during a season.</p>
<p>You can store your material in one of our 40 lockable storage boxes. Of course we also provide toilets, fresh water showers as well as washing areas for the equipment, a chill-out area, WIFI and several compressors to fill the kites. Furthermore, we offer you food &amp; drinks at our snack bar, which you can enjoy in the hammocks, the chill-out area, by the pool or on the sun loungers.</p>
<p>In the morning the Meltemi blows with about 2-3 Bft in calm sea, but increases constantly towards noon. At 5-6 Bft, the intermediates and experts among you will be drawn to the water. As soon as the first whitecaps can be seen, the professionals get their money&#8217;s worth.</p>
<p>On the sandbank 30m from the shore, on good days in the evening hours, there can be a slight wave for riding off or jumping. In addition, further out a nice swell is waiting for you to ride. And the best thing about it: from June to the end of October you can enjoy all this comfortably in board shorts.</p>
<p>In the months of May and October, i.e. in the early and late season, the spot offers you a very special highlight through the &#8220;Tramontana&#8221;. The fresh wind then blows with up to 8 Bft from Turkey over to us, whereby the waves on the sandbank can already become 2 m high. For beginners, the somewhat more difficult conditions are then no longer recommended.</p>
